title: Claude Code: Nested Sub-Agents, Marketplace & Artifacts (2026)
content:
## Overview

The CLI 2026.6 release train made three previously-experimental Claude Code features generally available: **nested sub-agents**, **fallback model chains**, and a **community tool marketplace**. July 2026 followed with Artifacts inside Claude Code sessions and admin-side device verification. This page tracks the additions on top of the baseline covered in [Claude Code Overview](claude-code-overview).

---

## Nested Sub-Agents

Previously, a coordinator Claude instance could spawn subagents, but those subagents couldn't spawn their own. As of CLI v2.1.172 (June 10, 2026), **sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents, up to 5 levels deep**.

- Each agent in the tree can be assigned a distinct role, model, and constraint set.
- Each level operates with its own context window, so depth doesn't dilute the parent's context.
- Practical use: a top-level coordinator delegates a subsystem to a level-2 agent, which itself breaks that subsystem into per-file level-3 agents — useful for large refactors or audits that need layered decomposition rather than a flat fan-out.
- Documented pitfall: token cost compounds with depth, since each level's context and prompt overhead is paid independently — shallow, targeted nesting outperforms maxing out all 5 levels by default.

---

## Fallback Models

The `fallbackModel` setting lets you configure an ordered list of models Claude Code tries in sequence. If the primary model hits a rate limit or is unavailable, Claude Code automatically retries with the next model in the chain — reducing session interruptions during high-demand periods without manual intervention.

---

## Community Tool Marketplace

A new marketplace for discovering and installing community-published tools and plugins:

```
claude marketplace search <query>
claude marketplace install <tool-name>
```

**Important:** community-published tools are not reviewed or guaranteed by Anthropic. Review a tool's source and requested permissions before installing, the same way you would with any third-party package.

---

## Artifacts in Claude Code (July 2026)

Claude Code sessions can now turn work-in-progress into **live, shareable web pages** that update in place as the session continues — PR walkthroughs, incident pages, dashboards, and checklists. For Team and Enterprise plans, this includes private org-only sharing and version history (in beta).

---

## Trusted Devices for Remote Control

Team and Enterprise admins can now require **device verification** before a member is allowed to view or steer a local Claude Code session remotely. This closes a gap where Remote Control previously trusted any device tied to an authorized account.

---

## Other July 2026 Additions

- **`claude mcp login` / `claude mcp logout`** — authenticate or clear credentials for a configured MCP server directly from the shell, instead of the interactive `/mcp` menu.
- **`/doctor`** — a full setup checkup command for diagnosing configuration issues.
- Lower-memory auto-update downloads and improved Windows reliability.
- Transcript protection, smarter PR linking, and improved background task handling for agent workflows.

---

## Default Model Update

Claude Sonnet 5 (see [Claude Model History](claude-model-history)) became Claude Code's default model shortly after its June 30, 2026 release, bringing a native 1M-token context window to the default coding experience.
